breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth removes the thin-walled tube approximation entirely and uses only the exact thick-walled torsion formula. The generated specification still computes and reports the thin-walled shear-flow result (τ_thin = 17.66 MPa) as part of the final answers, explicitly stating it is doing so 'as instructed.' This means the agent did not fully resolve the inconsistency — it retained the incorrect thin-walled model alongside the correct one rather than replacing it.
